Palette: keep the reference's silver-white and dark-violet identity with muted soft-lavender and blush highlights so the cutout fits a warm-white pastel website. No neon aura.
Background: ACTUAL transparent alpha, no background scene, no panel, no rounded-square frame, no cast-shadow plate, no surrounding sparkles or diagrams; website effects will be separate.
